old: “Seven hundred, seven hundred, not five hundred, right now, this minute, cash in hand!” Mitya added, sensing that something was wrong. “What’s the matter, _panie_? Don’t you trust me? I can’t hand over the whole three thousand all at once. If I did, you might come back to her tomorrow.... Besides, I haven’t got the three thousand on me. It’s at home in town,” faltered Mitya, his heart sinking with every word. “I swear it, the money is there, hidden away.”
